notes.title: v1.31: Overhauled Dance Generation
notes.content:
I completely overhauled the dance generation system for custom songs.

Overall, it should make much more interesting dance patterns that more closely match the music. It also likely increases the difficulty.

I also updated to the latest version of Focus Engine and OpenXR!

- Phr00t

notes.title: v1.30: New Dance Generation Algorithm
notes.content:
I've updated the dance pattern generation algorithm significantly. It now will section the song into areas where it prioritizes vocals and beats separately. Before, it mixed vocals and beats together, causing a bit too much chaos that didn't seem to match the music accurately -- especially at higher difficulties. The new system generally makes levels easier to complete (because there is a less "spam"), but should be more fun to play each song longer.

Please enjoy!

- Phr00t

notes.title: v1.28: VR list scrolling + easier return to the same song
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now use your VR touchpad or thumbstick to scroll up and down the music list. Use both thumbsticks for more velocity. You have to be pointed at the list for it to work.
[*] When you complete a song and return to the song selection screen, it will automatically select the same song. This makes it easier to redo the song and see saved high scores.
[/list]

- Phr00t

notes.title: v1.27: Added touchpad center press to pause the game
notes.content:
Vive controllers needed something mapped to in-game pause: center touchpress has been added!

- Phr00t

notes.title: v1.26: Combo Counter + Bug Fix
notes.content:
Now you can track how high of a combo you are making! Miss a hit while dancing, or hit an "avoid" block, and the combo counter resets.

This update also fixes a bug that caused hitting "avoid" blocks to not deduct points from your score or upset the audience.

Happy Holidays!

- Phr00t

notes.title: System Escape: New stealth action escape game!
v1.25: Update "hold" Generation & Keep Song if leaving prematurely
notes.content:
I tweaked how "holds" are generated (this is when a connected line of notes come at you). Now, you can have multiple small holds closer together, or a small hold not cancelling out a close "big" hold. It will also try and do a better job of making "holds" at the start of a singing section, instead of the middle.

I also made the song choice "stick" if you leave before the end of the song finishes (say, if you want to change difficulty and jump right back in).

Enjoy!

- Phr00t

notes.title: v1.22: Better segmentation detection + black background
notes.content:
This update changes how music segments (chorus etc.) are detected, which should better place "big" events like jumping and double hits. Due to this change, songs will need to be re-analyzed.

I also added a black box to where notes begin to make them easier to see.

This also updates PerformVR to the latest Focus Engine v4.5.3

- Phr00t

- Phr00t

notes.title: v1.19: Better timing for songs with long intros
notes.content: If a song has a long introduction (say 10-20 seconds), it will extend the playtime to compensate. For example, if you have "maximum playtime" set to 90 seconds, but there is a 20 second introduction before any notes are placed, the song will play for 110 seconds. This is done so you can have a consistent active playtime for varying songs.

notes.title: v1.18: Better dance patterns & visuals
notes.content:

[*] Improved holds, making them more accurate and placed a bit more often in useful spots
[*] Improved higher level difficulties. Instead of lots of notes, it will put more on vocals and interesting places of the song
[/olist]

Enjoy!
